endpoints.desc: Returns a list of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers active.

examples.title: cURL
examples.code: curl -X GET http://localhost:8000/v1/mcp/list

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

res = requests.get('http://localhost:8000/v1/mcp/list')
print(res.json())

examples.title: Node.js
Rust
examples.code:
let res = reqwest::get("http://localhost:8000/v1/mcp/list").await?;
println!("{:#?}", res.json::<serde_json::Value>().await?);

endpoints.desc: Registers a new MCP server endpoint.

examples.title: cURL
examples.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/mcp/install \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name": "GitHub MCP", "url": "http://localhost:8080", "auth_token": "ghp_123456789"}'

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {
    "name": "GitHub MCP",
    "url": "http://localhost:8080",
    "auth_token": "ghp_123456789"
}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/mcp/install', json=payload)
print(res.json())
